pages.title: Blobby Jars
pages.creator: Lanka Games
pages.description: Sort colorful blobs into matching containers in Blobby Jars. Pour from one jar into another that is empty or has the same color on top. Plan around the available space until every occupied jar contains a single color of blobs.

pages.title: Zombie Battle Royale
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Fight to be the last survivor in Zombie Battle Royale. Search the arena for weapons and rarer loot, then confront other players while staying inside the shrinking safe area. Choosing when to gather equipment and when to attack shapes each attempt to outlast the competition.

pages.title: Safari Story Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Travel a safari-themed map by clearing boards in Safari Story Mahjong. Match identical tiles that are uncovered and have an accessible side, removing pairs before time expires. Each finished layout moves the journey forward, with rewards available at milestones along the route.

pages.title: Mr Stickman Gunner
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Handle the kick of each shot in Mr Stickman Gunner. Battle through 2D encounters with firearms whose recoil can throw your stick figure off balance. Stronger weapons bring more force, making positioning and control part of the challenge alongside aiming at enemies.

pages.title: Block Sniper
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Take on shooting assignments in Block Sniper, using a sniper rifle in a world built from blocks. Locate the enemies required by each mission and line up your shots. Completing those objectives advances the sequence of block-world combat challenges.

pages.title: C.A.P.
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Defend an aircraft carrier from airborne attacks in C.A.P. Your plane fires automatically, leaving you to steer left and right through the enemy formations. Fly back over the carrier to replenish fuel and keep the patrol going while hostile aircraft threaten the ship.

pages.title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
pages.creator: Craft Game World RA
pages.description: Match Labubu characters in Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure. Arrange three matching pieces to clear them from the puzzle board and work through the level objectives. Each completed stage opens another part of the matching adventure, with the character-themed pieces at the center of play.

pages.title: SUV Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive an SUV through busy highway traffic in SUV Traffic Racer. Pass other vehicles without crashing and keep the run going to increase your distance score. Unlock additional SUVs and improve their performance as you work toward longer, more controlled drives.

pages.title: SuStainable
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Protect a museum's collection in SuStainable. Patrol as a security guard, gather clues about vandalism, and pursue the people responsible for damaging the art. Use hints to guide the investigation, question suspects, and confront vandals before more exhibits are harmed.

pages.title: Idle Bathroom Empire Tycoon
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Turn a small public restroom into a larger business in Idle Bathroom Empire Tycoon. Improve the facilities and expand the services available to visitors. Spending income on further upgrades supports the next stage of growth as the bathroom operation becomes more extensive.

pages.title: 2048 Cube Merge
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aim numbered cubes into the play area in 2048 Cube Merge. Bring equal values together to produce larger numbers and continue building toward 2048. Choose your shots with the developing arrangement in mind, then use the available upgrades and customization options as play progresses.

pages.title: Food Merge
pages.creator: Stoneforge Games
pages.description: Prepare customer orders by combining ingredients in Food Merge. Match the right food items to produce the requested dishes and serve them before the deadline. Later orders demand more involved combinations, making the order of your merges important when several customers need attention.

pages.title: Run N Shoot
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Move between gunfights in Run N Shoot. Bring enemies into your sights and fire as the character advances through the level's encounters. Different enemy positions and boss appearances change the shooting sequence, requiring you to track the next threat along the route.

pages.title: Monster Merge Legends Alive
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drop creatures into the play area in Monster Merge Legends Alive. Matching monsters combine into a higher-ranked form, adding points and changing the space available for your next drop. Hold to position a creature, then release it where you want the next merge to happen.

pages.title: Christmas Merge
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Build larger holiday pieces in Christmas Merge by dropping matching items together. Each successful combination creates a new piece and adds to the score. Choose a landing position that supports further merges as the pile grows and larger Christmas figures appear.

pages.title: Chicken Blast
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear groups of matching chickens in Chicken Blast. Tap clusters of the same color to remove them, create room, and increase your score. Use bonuses and power-ups to deal with awkward arrangements while continuing the game's sequence of colorful block-clearing decisions.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Cats
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Fit an assortment of cat-shaped pieces into the board in Block Puzzle Cats. Drag each shape into a position that leaves room for the remaining cats, filling the layout to finish the puzzle. Progress through new arrangements and unlock more cats along the way.

pages.title: Raft Life
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Expand a floating home in Raft Life by gathering resources and building more raft sections. Chop wood, catch fish, and grow food to support your life on the water. Keep an eye on sharks while developing the space into a larger settlement.

pages.title: Basketball Kings 2024
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Shoot for a higher basketball score in Basketball Kings 2024. Make baskets before the clock runs out, playing across four different court settings. Successful scoring unlocks more basketballs, giving you additional choices as you return to improve your timed shooting performance.

pages.title: Rugby Kicks Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Kick rugby balls between the posts in Rugby Kicks Game. Swipe to set the direction and strength of each attempt, adjusting for the wind and defensive shields. Hit bonus targets to gain extra balls and extend a run that starts with three attempts.

pages.title: Counter Combat Multiplayer
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Join a team gunfight in Counter Combat Multiplayer. Play on the SWAT or terrorist side, move through the map, and confront the opposing team with first-person shooting controls. Bomb-defusal objectives and the scoreboard give the combat a team-based goal beyond individual encounters.

pages.title: Donhoop
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Organize the colored rings in Donhoop by moving donuts between sticks. Place a ring onto an empty stick or onto a matching color, keeping enough space for later moves. Continue rearranging the stack until the donuts are sorted into their proper color groups.

pages.title: Track Rotate
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Turn disconnected road sections into a usable route in Track Rotate. Rotate the track pieces to join their entrances and exits before the timer runs down. Look across the whole layout so that fixing one connection does not leave the next part pointing away.

pages.title: Zombie City Master
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Help a woman escape danger in Zombie City Master. Search the zombie-filled town for useful objects and put them to work against the creatures blocking her progress. Choosing and using the right props provides a way through the city's survival puzzles.

pages.title: Hug and Kis Station Escape
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide Hug and Kis through a station in Hug and Kis Station Escape. Move the two characters around the level, collect diamonds, and find the key needed for the exit. Use their double jumps to reach platforms and bring the pair to the door.

pages.title: Head Soccer 2022
pages.creator: BestGamesDevelopers
pages.description: Play football with oversized-headed characters in Head Soccer 2022. Pick a footballer and compete against the computer in tournament play or face a friend in versus mode. Three fields provide different settings for the goal-scoring matches as you try to beat the opposition.

pages.title: Puzzle Parking 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Move cars through confined layouts in Puzzle Parking 3D. Click a vehicle to send it along its path, choosing an order that keeps the routes usable. Later parking puzzles introduce features such as rotating platforms and switches that change how a car can reach its destination.

pages.title: Get Color Fast
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Match your shot to a rotating target in Get Color Fast. Watch the central circle's colored sections and release when the corresponding section is in position. Accurate timing adds points, while the movement of the wheel keeps changing the window for the next hit.

pages.title: Furious Ride
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Fight off the vehicles chasing you in Furious Ride. Aim at enemies approaching from behind and fire to stop their pursuit as the road battle continues. Collect diamonds and spend them on character improvements to support later encounters with the armed pursuers.

pages.title: Cannon Shooter
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Destroy rising platforms with colored cannonballs in Cannon Shooter. Release balls from the pipe and break each line before it reaches the cannon. Shots are limited, and hitting spikes costs a life, so choose the timing of each volley carefully.

pages.title: Princess Cosmetic Kit Factory Makeup Maker Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Produce a range of beauty products in Princess Cosmetic Kit Factory Makeup Maker Game. Work through the steps for making lipstick, nail polish, and cosmetic containers, choosing colors and designs along the way. Finish the packaging to prepare the completed products for customers.

pages.title: Hextetris
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Arrange falling pieces in Hextetris, which combines a block-stacking puzzle with matching elements. Use the arrow keys and Space to control the pieces, forming useful arrangements as the board develops. Build your score while the game's difficulty increases through successive levels.

pages.title: Roldana
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Process raw blocks into saleable goods in Roldana. Run the material through the pulley system to earn money, then invest the proceeds in improvements. Upgrading the pulleys and blocks changes the production process and helps the operation develop beyond its initial setup.

pages.title: Christmas Mascots Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find matching festive characters in Christmas Mascots Memory. Turn over cards to reveal their pictures, then remember those positions when looking for a partner. Clear the pairs within the time limit and move on to another Christmas-themed card arrangement.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decoration and Dress Up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a festive setting in Christmas Tree Decoration and Dress Up. Choose decorations for the house and Christmas tree, arranging the holiday details before styling the princess. Complete the scene with an outfit that suits the celebration and the decorations you selected.

pages.title: Racing Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Customize a car and take it into competition in Racing Cars. Race against computer-controlled opponents across thirty levels, aiming to finish ahead of the pack. Adjust your vehicle's appearance between attempts as you work through the game's sequence of races.

pages.title: Infinite Jumpy Cat
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help a cat cross a series of platforms in Infinite Jumpy Cat. Hold the input to set how far the next jump will travel, then release to launch. Judge each gap carefully so the cat lands on another platform instead of falling between them.

pages.title: Twin Sisters Wedding
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Style Clara and Sophia for their shared wedding day in Twin Sisters Wedding. Choose bridal dresses and matching accessories for both sisters, comparing the available looks as you work. Complete each bride's outfit so the pair are ready for the ceremony together.

pages.title: Ice Cream Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble pictures of frozen desserts in Ice Cream Jigsaw. Move the scattered pieces into their matching positions, using the colors and shapes of each image to find connections. Choose among twelve ice-cream pictures and complete their jigsaw layouts one piece at a time.

pages.title: Vegetable Snake
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Guide a growing snake toward vegetables in Vegetable Snake. Eat the produce to extend its body, then adjust your route as the longer snake needs more room to move. Different locations provide settings for continuing the food-collecting challenge.

pages.title: Lamborghini Sian Roadster Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild photographs of a supercar in Lamborghini Sian Roadster Puzzle. Choose one of six images and select a layout with sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Connect the scattered sections until the complete car picture is restored.

pages.title: Colorful Dragons Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Create rows of matching dragons in Colorful Dragons Match 3. Arrange at least three pieces of the same color together to remove them and score points. Keep making matches while watching the side gauge, since letting it empty ends the attempt.

pages.title: Trump Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Put together portrait pictures in Trump Jigsaw. Complete puzzles to unlock more of the twelve available images, choosing layouts with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Match the edges and picture details to restore each portrait from its scattered sections.

pages.title: RacingMasters
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Build a collection of armed racing cars in RacingMasters. Compete with vehicles that have different abilities and weapons, then spend earned coins on upgrades or additional cars. Diamonds provide further extras as you develop your garage for the next race.

pages.title: Billiard 8 Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Line up cue shots and pocket balls in Billiard 8 Ball. Adjust your aim across the table and strike the cue ball to send other balls toward the pockets. Plan around the remaining positions as you work toward winning the billiards match.

pages.title: Pro Driver Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color a collection of eight vehicle pictures in Pro Driver Coloring. Select colors from the palette and apply them to the drawing, changing the appearance of each car as you work. Use the camera option to save a picture of your completed design.

pages.title: Baby Hazel At Beach
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Spend a day by the sea with Hazel in Baby Hazel At Beach. Help her with beach activities, swimming, and refreshments by selecting the objects she needs. Follow her requests and interact with the scene to keep the outing moving from one activity to the next.

pages.title: Dragons.ro
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Control a young dragon in Dragons.ro, flying through its world and using fire against threats. Practice movement and attacks as the dragon faces combat around its home. Staying aware of enemies helps you protect its territory while continuing the aerial battle.

pages.title: Moto Bike Rush Driving Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through city streets and off-road settings in Moto Bike Rush Driving Game. Steer past traffic and keep moving without a collision during the endless driving challenge. Watch approaching vehicles and choose a clear line when overtaking them.

pages.title: Cute Planes Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Paint aircraft pictures in Cute Planes Coloring. Pick one of eight drawings, choose from twenty-three colors, and fill the image with your preferred combination. Work through the details of each plane, then save the finished picture when you are satisfied with its appearance.

pages.title: Rotating Spike
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Keep a small dot moving safely inside a circle in Rotating Spike. React to the spikes around its route and adjust your timing to avoid a collision. The longer the dot survives, the further you can push the score on the next attempt.

pages.title: Kitty Adventure
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Help a kitten make its way home in Kitty Adventure. Guide the cat through the levels and collect the jewels along the route. Reaching the end of each stage brings the kitten closer to finishing its journey back to its owner.

pages.title: Crazy Car Racing Stunts 2019
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Drive across elevated stunt courses in Crazy Car Racing Stunts 2019. Take the car onto large ramps and routes above the city, controlling its speed and direction through each section. Use the driving keys and brake to handle the approach to the next stunt.

pages.title: Roll Orange
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Bring an orange safely down to the ground in Roll Orange. Remove supporting boxes and platforms in an order that creates a usable path. Watch where the fruit will roll or fall, keeping it away from bombs and cacti while solving the level.

pages.title: Pixel by Numbers
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Complete pixel pictures by following color codes in Pixel by Numbers. Select the indicated color and fill the numbered squares that match it. Zoom into the image to work on small details as the separate colored cells gradually reveal the finished picture.

pages.title: Top Shooter io
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Fight pixel-style deathmatches in Top Shooter io. Join rooms with other players or battle bots, searching for useful power-ups while attacking opponents. Change your character's skin and return to the arena to compete for more eliminations during the shooting matches.

pages.title: GunGame Poligon Battle Royale
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Choose weapons and enter block-style combat in GunGame Poligon Battle Royale. Fight bots, face zombies, or play survival battles with friends across its available modes. Move with the keyboard and switch guns as different encounters call for a change in firepower.

pages.title: US Army Prisoner Transport Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Complete prisoner-transfer assignments in US Army Prisoner Transport Game 3D. Take control of a transport vehicle and drive the captives along the mission route. Follow each job's destination requirements while handling the vehicle through the stages of the transfer.

pages.title: Christmas Knife Hit
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Throw knives at a rotating target in Christmas Knife Hit. Find openings between blades already stuck in the board, since hitting one ends the sequence. Strike apples for extra points while working through the holiday-themed knife-throwing stages.

pages.title: Real Gangster Simulator Grand City
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Explore a crime-themed city in Real Gangster Simulator Grand City. Move through the streets, take on missions, and fight when the action requires it. Use the keyboard to control your character as you work through the tasks available around the open city.

pages.title: Don't Touch The Wall
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Pass through openings without striking the barriers in Don't Touch The Wall. Time your movement to enter the middle gap and continue past each wall. Every successful passage increases the score, while a collision cuts the attempt short.

pages.title: Box Race
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Race small cars around a cardboard-box setting in Box Race. Steer through the miniature course and try to get ahead of the opposing vehicle. Four stages provide successive races as you work toward finishing in front on each track.

pages.title: Audi RS Q3 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of a performance SUV in Audi RS Q3 Puzzle. Select from six images and four piece-count settings, ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces. Match the scattered details of the car and background until the chosen photograph is complete.

pages.title: Mind Games for 2 Player
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Challenge a friend to a collection of tabletop games in Mind Games for 2 Player. Choose from options including chess, checkers, Ludo, mancala, and Connect Four. Use the mouse to make moves as each game presents its own rules and winning objective.

pages.title: Ultimate Dunk Line 3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw a route for a basketball in Ultimate Dunk Line 3. Sketch lines that redirect the moving ball toward the basket, accounting for the angle at which it will meet them. Shape the path carefully so the ball reaches the hoop instead of dropping away.

pages.title: Sweet Babies Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find the changes between paired scenes in Sweet Babies Differences. Compare the two baby-themed illustrations and select details that do not match. Search through each level's pictures until all required differences are marked and the next comparison becomes available.

pages.title: Touchdown Pro
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Carry the ball past defenders in Touchdown Pro. Dodge tackles as you move toward a touchdown, using slow motion when you need more time to react. Earn credits and unlock stronger players to take into further runs against the defense.

pages.title: Sweet Sugar Match
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Clear level targets by matching sweets in Sweet Sugar Match. Swap pieces to make combinations of three or more, removing them from the board and creating new arrangements. Work toward each stage's objectives, using larger combinations and special pieces to help complete them.

pages.title: Snake
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Guide a snake around a retro-style playfield in Snake. Eat fruit to grow longer, planning a route that leaves room for the expanding body. Use the available avatars and skills to vary later attempts while pursuing more food and a higher score.

pages.title: EG Sky Troops
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fly rescue missions in EG Sky Troops. Destroy enemy planes and save people to complete assignments, earning coins according to your rescue results. Spend those coins on aircraft improvements as more missions become available and the aerial action continues.

pages.title: Couple Hand Casting
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Make a wedding keepsake in Couple Hand Casting. Help the pair create a cast of their joined hands, then decorate the finished piece with flowers and other details. Work through the craft's stages to turn the hand shapes into a display for the couple.

pages.title: Pick Head
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Throw knives at rotating heads in Pick Head. Aim for clear spaces without hitting a blade already in place, adjusting as the targets change speed. Collect coins for another chance and take on boss targets as the throwing challenge advances.

pages.title: Flip the Bottle
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Toss a bottle and try to make it land upright in Flip the Bottle. Judge the throw, watch the rotation, and build successful landings. Earn coins to unlock more bottles and other throwable objects, then test their flips on another attempt.

pages.title: Princess Winter Makeover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a cold-weather look in Princess Winter Makeover. Apply makeup, compare the available clothing, and put together an outfit for the winter event. Match the selected pieces and finishing details to complete the princess's makeover before she heads out.

pages.title: Wire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Steer a moving wire through a scrolling obstacle course in Wire. Use the mouse or tap controls to alter its path, finding space between the barriers ahead. Keep the wire clear of collisions to travel farther and improve on the distance of your previous attempt.
